{{Quote|Hear that? You've got a face like gogomar guts.|Anakin Skywalker to Bariss Offee|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Gogomars''' were creatures of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. They were used as sacrifices by the [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of the nomadic [[Alwari]]. They would read the entrails of the dead gogomar in order to resolve important affairs.<ref name="AS" />
